model.name: Branch-line coupler (2.4 GHz)
model.description: 90 degree hybrid: 35.4 ohm and 50 ohm quarter-wave branches on a RO4003C-like substrate, four 50 ohm lumped ports.
model.reference: D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., sec. 7.5 (quadrature hybrid)

params.label: Branch length scale
params.description: Trims both branch lengths; 1.0 = textbook centre-line quarter waves (centred at 2.49 GHz here, the T-junctions shorten the electrical length), 1.035 centres the coupler at 2.40 GHz
